prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW landscape character development sheet for a terrifying teenage Indonesian girl zombie in an illustrated survival-horror short. The two images supplied are references for the episode's gritty, inked, dark-shaded comic style and car proportions ONLY; do not repeat the old male design. Make her a distinct believable Indonesian teenager, about 16–17, medium brown skin, shoulder-length uneven black hair hanging damply around her face, modest everyday faded T-shirt and loose overshirt; no cultural costume, symbols, uniform, or sexualization.

Create a character whose seated appearance is genuinely frightening, not simply sad or tired: eerily wide, unblinking eyes trained directly on the driver; one milky eye and one dark eye; a disturbingly still, too-wide closed-mouth half-smile, subtle mottled ashen discoloration around her eyes and mouth, and a slightly off-center head tilt with anatomically plausible neck and shoulders. Her posture is predatory and purposeful: she sits unnaturally motionless, then leans forward out of the shadows with tense shoulders and fingers slowly curling over the front-seat headrest, as if she has already been watching the driver for a long time. Scary uncanny intent, emotional impact and readable dark silhouette rather than a generic growling monster. Faint dried marks and infection texture only; no exposed tissue, explicit gore, dismemberment, or blood spray. Expression must read unmistakably sinister even at small phone size.

Prioritize the SEATED character: the lower half of the sheet is a large clear, properly lit waist-up full-character key pose in the rear seat leaning forward toward the viewer, fingers clasping the driver's headrest with plausible hand anatomy, eye contact visible in the shadows; chair, shoulders, head, neck and contact all visible. The top has three separate larger head-and-shoulder studies of exactly the same girl: neutral blank stare, a three-quarter forward lean and direct reveal glare with the unnerving smile. Consistent face, hair, outfit, age and lighting in all views. Do not crop her face, make her look like an adult, or let her hair hide her eyes. Textured blue-gray shadows with restrained red taillight edge lighting, clear face, same dark comic illustration style as the reference, moderate contrast. Neutral dark studio background for the studies. No typography, captions, logos, watermark or extra characters. This is an unapproved concept character sheet, not an edit to a movie frame.
